+# Copyright (c) Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. and/or its subsidiaries.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause-Clear
+
+name: Release gems to RubyGems.org
+
+# Builds and publishes gems to rubygems.org whenever their version.rb changes on main.
+#
+# A git tag "GEM_NAME-gem-VERSION" is created on the release commit so the
+# exact source that produced each published gem is always traceable.
+# The tag check also makes the workflow idempotent: re-running it for the
+# same version is a no-op.
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - main
+    paths:
+      - 'tools/ruby-gems/*/lib/*/version.rb'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      gem:
+        description: 'Gem to release (idlc, udb, udb-gen, udb_helpers, or all)'
+        required: false
+        default: 'all'
+
+jobs:
+  detect-gems:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    outputs:
+      gems: ${{ steps.set-gems.outputs.gems }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 2  # Need to check changed files
+
+      - name: Detect changed gems
+        id: set-gems
+        run: |
+          # Manual dispatch - release specified gem or all gems
+          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
+            if [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.gem }}" == "all" ]]; then
+              GEMS='["idlc","udb","udb-gen","udb_helpers"]'
+            else
+              GEMS='["${{ github.event.inputs.gem }}"]'
+            fi
+          else
+            # Push event - detect which version.rb files changed
+            CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD)
+            GEMS="["
+            SEPARATOR=""
+
+            if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "tools/ruby-gems/idlc/lib/idlc/version.rb"; then
+              GEMS="${GEMS}${SEPARATOR}\"idlc\""
+              SEPARATOR=","
+            fi
+
+            if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/version.rb"; then
+              GEMS="${GEMS}${SEPARATOR}\"udb\""
+              SEPARATOR=","
+            fi
+
+            if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "tools/ruby-gems/udb-gen/lib/udb-gen/version.rb"; then
+              GEMS="${GEMS}${SEPARATOR}\"udb-gen\""
+              SEPARATOR=","
+            fi
+
+            if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "tools/ruby-gems/udb_helpers/lib/udb_helpers/version.rb"; then
+              GEMS="${GEMS}${SEPARATOR}\"udb_helpers\""
+              SEPARATOR=","
+            fi
+
+            GEMS="${GEMS}]"
+          fi
+
+          echo "gems=$GEMS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "Gems to release: $GEMS"
+
+  release-gem:
+    needs: detect-gems
+    if: needs.detect-gems.outputs.gems != '[]'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    permissions:
+      contents: write   # needed to push the release tag
+
+    strategy:
+      matrix:
+        gem: ${{ fromJson(needs.detect-gems.outputs.gems) }}
+        include:
+          - gem: idlc
+            gem_dir: idlc
+            gen_dir: idlc_gem
+            version_module: "Idl::Compiler"
+            rake_task: idlc
+          - gem: udb
+            gem_dir: udb
+            gen_dir: udb_gem
+            version_module: "Udb"
+            rake_task: udb
+          - gem: udb-gen
+            gem_dir: udb-gen
+            gen_dir: udb_gen_gem
+            version_module: "UdbGen"
+            rake_task: udb_gen
+          - gem: udb_helpers
+            gem_dir: udb_helpers
+            gen_dir: udb_helpers_gem
+            version_module: "Udb::Helpers"
+            rake_task: udb_helpers
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0  # Fetch full history to avoid merge-base errors
+
+      - name: Get gem version
+        id: version
+        run: |
+          VERSION=$(ruby -e "load 'tools/ruby-gems/${{ matrix.gem_dir }}/lib/${{ matrix.gem_dir }}/version.rb'; puts ${{ matrix.version_module }}.version")
+          echo "VERSION=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "Releasing ${{ matrix.gem }} version $VERSION"
+
+      - name: Check if release tag already exists
+        run: |
+          if git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/${{ matrix.gem }}-gem-${VERSION}" | grep -q .; then
+            echo "TAG_EXISTS=true" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+            echo "Tag ${{ matrix.gem }}-gem-${VERSION} already exists – skipping release."
+          else
+            echo "TAG_EXISTS=false" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          fi
+
+      - name: Set up Ruby
+        if: env.TAG_EXISTS == 'false'
+        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
+        with:
+          ruby-version: '3.2'
+          bundler-cache: true
+          working-directory: tools/ruby-gems/${{ matrix.gem_dir }}
+
+      - name: Prepare gem staging directory
+        if: env.TAG_EXISTS == 'false'
+        run: |
+          cd tools/ruby-gems/${{ matrix.gem_dir }}
+          bundle exec rake release:${{ matrix.rake_task }}:prepare
+
+      - name: Build gem
+        if: env.TAG_EXISTS == 'false'
+        run: |
+          cd gen/${{ matrix.gen_dir }}
+          BUNDLE_GEMFILE= gem build ${{ matrix.gem }}.gemspec
+
+      - name: Push gem to RubyGems.org
+        if: env.TAG_EXISTS == 'false'
+        env:
+          GEM_HOST_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RUBYGEM_API_KEY }}
+        run: gem push "gen/${{ matrix.gen_dir }}/${{ matrix.gem }}-${VERSION}.gem"
+
+      - name: Create and push release tag
+        if: env.TAG_EXISTS == 'false'
+        run: |
+          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
+          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
+          git tag "${{ matrix.gem }}-gem-${VERSION}"
+          git push origin "${{ matrix.gem }}-gem-${VERSION}"

 # frozen_string_literal: true
 
+require "pathname"
+require "fileutils"
+
 IDLC_ROOT = Kernel.__dir__
 
+namespace :release do
+  namespace :idlc do
+    desc "Prepare a copy of the idlc gem for release under gen/idlc_gem (or IDLC_GEM_GEN_DIR)"
+    task :prepare do
+      idlc_gem_src = Pathname.new(IDLC_ROOT)
+      repo_root = (idlc_gem_src / ".." / ".." / "..").realpath
+      idlc_gem_dst = Pathname.new(ENV.fetch("IDLC_GEM_GEN_DIR", (repo_root / "gen" / "idlc_gem").to_s))
+
+      puts "Preparing idlc gem release copy at #{idlc_gem_dst}"
+
+      # Remove existing destination
+      FileUtils.rm_rf(idlc_gem_dst)
+
+      # Before copying, record the realpath of each top-level symlink in the source
+      # so we can resolve them after the copy (the symlinks point into the monorepo
+      # and would be broken at a different directory depth).
+      symlink_targets = {}
+      idlc_gem_src.children.select(&:symlink?).each do |s|
+        symlink_targets[s.basename.to_s] = s.realpath
+      end
+
+      # Copy the gem source directory contents (symlinks are copied as symlinks).
+      # Copy children individually so contents land directly in idlc_gem_dst/
+      # rather than in idlc_gem_dst/idlc/ (cp_r behaviour when dst already exists).
+      FileUtils.mkdir_p(idlc_gem_dst)
+      FileUtils.cp_r(idlc_gem_src.children.map(&:to_s), idlc_gem_dst.to_s)
+
+      # Remove Gemfile and Gemfile.lock from the copy.
+      # These reference local gem paths that only exist inside the monorepo
+      # and would cause `gem build` to fail elsewhere.
+      FileUtils.rm_f(idlc_gem_dst / "Gemfile")
+      FileUtils.rm_f(idlc_gem_dst / "Gemfile.lock")
+
+      # Resolve (or remove) each top-level symlink in the copy
+      symlink_targets.each do |name, target|
+        dst_entry = idlc_gem_dst / name
+        FileUtils.rm_rf(dst_entry)
+        # Skip entries whose target doesn't exist
+        next unless target.exist?
+
+        if target.directory?
+          FileUtils.cp_r(target, dst_entry)
+        else
+          FileUtils.cp(target, dst_entry)
+        end
+      end
+
+      puts "idlc gem release copy ready at #{idlc_gem_dst}"
+    end
+  end
+end
+

+#!/usr/bin/env ruby
+# Copyright (c) Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. and/or its subsidiaries.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause-Clear
+
+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+# Script to check if a gem's source files have changed without a version bump.
+# Used in CI to enforce version bumps when gems are modified.
+
+require "pathname"
+
+# Gem configurations: name, source directory, and version file
+GEMS = [
+  {
+    name: "udb",
+    dir: "tools/ruby-gems/udb",
+    version_file: "tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/version.rb",
+    version_method: "Udb.version"
+  },
+  {
+    name: "idlc",
+    dir: "tools/ruby-gems/idlc",
+    version_file: "tools/ruby-gems/idlc/lib/idlc/version.rb",
+    version_method: "Idl::Compiler.version"
+  },
+  {
+    name: "udb_helpers",
+    dir: "tools/ruby-gems/udb_helpers",
+    version_file: "tools/ruby-gems/udb_helpers/lib/udb_helpers/version.rb",
+    version_method: "Udb::Helpers.version"
+  },
+  {
+    name: "udb-gen",
+    dir: "tools/ruby-gems/udb-gen",
+    version_file: "tools/ruby-gems/udb-gen/lib/udb-gen/version.rb",
+    version_method: "UdbGen.version"
+  }
+].freeze
+
+def get_changed_files(base_ref)
+  # Get list of changed files compared to base branch. Retry fetch if needed
+  cmd = "git diff --name-only #{base_ref}...HEAD 2>&1"
+  output = `#{cmd}`
+  if $?.exitstatus != 0
+    warn "Initial git diff failed: #{output}"
+    # Try fetching the base branch and retry
+    system("git fetch --no-tags --prune --no-recurse-submodules origin main")
+    output = `#{cmd}`
+    if $?.exitstatus != 0
+      warn "Retry git diff failed: #{output}"
+      # Fallback: list all tracked files to avoid false negatives in CI
+      files = `git ls-files 2>/dev/null`.lines.map(&:strip)
+      warn "Falling back to listing all tracked files (#{files.size} files)"
+      return files
+    end
+  end
+  output.lines.map(&:strip)
+end
+
+def get_gem_version(version_file)
+  # Read version from the version file
+  content = File.read(version_file)
+  # Extract version string using regex (matches x.y.z format)
+  if content =~ /["'](\d+\.\d+\.\d+)["']/
+    $1
+  else
+    nil
+  end
+end
+
+def check_gem(gem_config, changed_files, base_ref)
+  gem_name = gem_config[:name]
+  gem_dir = gem_config[:dir]
+  version_file = gem_config[:version_file]
+
+  # Check if any files in the gem directory have changed
+  gem_files_changed = changed_files.any? { |f| f.start_with?(gem_dir) }
+
+  return :no_changes unless gem_files_changed
+
+  # Check if the version file itself changed
+  version_file_changed = changed_files.include?(version_file)
+
+  if version_file_changed
+    # Version file changed, so version was bumped - OK
+    return :version_bumped
+  end
+
+  # Files changed but version didn't - check if version is actually different
+  # (in case version was bumped in a different way, like find-replace)
+  current_version = get_gem_version(version_file)
+  base_version_content = `git show #{base_ref}:#{version_file} 2>&1`
+
+  if $?.exitstatus != 0
+    # File might not exist in base branch (new gem)
+    return :new_gem
+  end
+
+  base_version = nil
+  if base_version_content =~ /["'](\d+\.\d+\.\d+)["']/
+    base_version = $1
+  end
+
+  if current_version != base_version
+    # Version changed but file wasn't in git diff (shouldn't normally happen)
+    return :version_bumped
+  end
+
+  # Files changed but version didn't - FAIL
+  return :version_not_bumped
+end
+
+def main
+  # Get base branch from argument or default to origin/main
+  base_ref = ARGV[0] || "origin/main"
+
+  # Ensure we have the latest base branch
+  system("git fetch origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main 2>/dev/null")
+
+  changed_files = get_changed_files(base_ref)
+
+  if changed_files.empty?
+    puts "No files changed."
+    exit 0
+  end
+
+  puts "Checking gem version bumps..."
+  puts "Base ref: #{base_ref}"
+  puts
+
+  failures = []
+
+  GEMS.each do |gem_config|
+    gem_name = gem_config[:name]
+    status = check_gem(gem_config, changed_files, base_ref)
+
+    case status
+    when :no_changes
+      puts "✓ #{gem_name}: No changes"
+    when :version_bumped
+      current_version = get_gem_version(gem_config[:version_file])
+      puts "✓ #{gem_name}: Version bumped to #{current_version}"
+    when :new_gem
+      puts "✓ #{gem_name}: New gem (no base version)"
+    when :version_not_bumped
+      current_version = get_gem_version(gem_config[:version_file])
+      puts "✗ #{gem_name}: Files changed but version not bumped (current: #{current_version})"
+      failures << gem_name
+    end
+  end
+
+  if failures.any?
+    puts
+    puts "ERROR: The following gems have source changes without version bumps:"
+    failures.each { |name| puts "  - #{name}" }
+    puts
+    puts "Please bump the version in the version.rb file for each modified gem."
+    exit 1
+  end
+
+  puts
+  puts "All gem version checks passed!"
+  exit 0
+end
+
+main if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
